Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Main game controller. Owns a single game instance and uses the State pattern to delegate action handling to the current GameState. Thread safety: all model mutations are serialized through gameLock. Multiple client threads may call handleAction(PlayerAction) concurrently.

    • GameController

      public GameController(ViewUpdater viewUpdater, GameModel restoredModel)
      Persistence restore constructor: wraps an already-initialized model deserialized from a snapshot instead of creating a fresh one. Re-injects the live viewUpdater into the model and rebuilds the in-memory lookups the controller keeps outside the model (playerMap, and the offer order when the game was suspended mid action-resolution).
      Parameters:
      viewUpdater - the rebuilt updater for the reattached match
      restoredModel - the model graph loaded from disk

  • Method Details

    • handleAction

      public void handleAction(PlayerAction action)
      Central action dispatch, called by MainController. Acquires the game lock, then delegates to the current state (derived from the model's current phase).

    • transitionTo

      public void transitionTo(GamePhase newPhase)
      Transitions the game to a new phase. Called by GameState implementations when the phase should change. Must be called while the gameLock is held. Calls onExit on the old state, asks the model to update its phase (which notifies observers), then calls onEnter on the new state.

    • startGame

      public void startGame(List<Player> players)
      Initializes and starts the game. Called by MainController when enough players are in the lobby.
      Parameters:
      players - list of players (2-5)

    • forceGameOver

      public void forceGameOver(String endMessage)
      Forces the game to end immediately (FA3): used when the sole-survivor timeout expires and the only connected player wins by default. Transitions the model to GamePhase.GAME_OVER and broadcasts a GameOverMessage.
      Parameters:
      endMessage - human-readable summary of how the game ended
